## 2. Master Directory of 10 Clinical Landing Pages

### Page 01: Pigmentation Treatment in South Bengaluru
- **Canonical URL:** https://www.medicareskin.com/treatments/skin/pigmentation-treatment/
- **SEO Title:** Pigmentation Treatment in Bangalore | Medicare Skin
- **Meta Description:** Understand causes of dark spots, melasma and post-acne marks. Explore dermatologist-led pigmentation treatment near Yelachenahalli, South Bengaluru.
- **Primary Intent:** Pigmentation treatment Bangalore; dermatologist for dark spots South Bengaluru.
- **Clinical Summary:** Facial pigmentation occurs when melanocytes produce excess melanin or distribute it unevenly due to UV/visible light, hormonal triggers, or post-inflammatory responses. Melasma typically presents as symmetrical brown/grey patches prone to relapse, whereas post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation (PIH) follows acne or skin injury.
- **Therapeutic Options:** Daily broad-spectrum SPF 30+ with iron oxides for visible-light photoprotection; topical prescription actives (azelaic acid, retinoids, supervised hydroquinone courses); calibrated superficial chemical peels; selective Q-switched laser for non-melasma spots. No single cream or laser guarantees permanent removal.

### Page 02: Q-Switched Laser Consultation
- **Canonical URL:** https://www.medicareskin.com/treatments/laser/q-switched-laser/
- **SEO Title:** Q-Switched Laser in Bangalore | Pigmentation Consultation
- **Meta Description:** Learn how Q-switched lasers target selected pigment spots, their risks for Indian skin and why melasma may recur. Dermatologist consultation in South Bengaluru.
- **Primary Intent:** Q-switched laser Bangalore; Q-switched Nd:YAG for pigmentation.
- **Clinical Governance Status:** Hold as a bookable service until specific clinic device model, operating protocols, and indication suitability are verified internally. Presented as an educational reference.
- **Clinical Mechanism:** Q-switched lasers deliver nanosecond high-peak-power pulses targeting pigment particles. Nanosecond pulses for pigment are fundamentally distinct from long-pulsed hair-removal lasers.
- **Risks for Skin of Colour:** Low-fluence laser toning in melasma carries risk of rebound hyperpigmentation and mottled hypopigmentation (white spots). Strict individual evaluation and patch-testing protocols are essential.

### Page 03: Laser Hair Reduction
- **Canonical URL:** https://www.medicareskin.com/treatments/laser/laser-hair-reduction/
- **SEO Title:** Laser Hair Reduction in Bangalore | Medicare Skin
- **Meta Description:** Learn about laser hair reduction for face, underarms, legs and body, including sessions, safety for Indian skin and aftercare. South Bengaluru dermatologist.
- **Primary Intent:** Laser hair removal Bangalore; laser hair reduction near JP Nagar.
- **Clinical Summary:** Light energy absorbed by melanin in active hair follicles (anagen phase) leads to follicular heating and long-term hair growth reduction.
- **Suitability for Indian Skin:** Long-pulsed 1064 nm Nd:YAG and suitable diode lasers with contact cooling are preferred for Fitzpatrick skin types IV–VI to protect epidermal melanin.
- **Sessions & Realities:** Multiple sessions (typically 6 or more) spaced across hair growth cycles are required. Maintenance sessions may be necessary, particularly for hormonally driven facial hair (e.g. PCOS). White or grey hairs lack pigment and do not respond to laser.

### Page 04: Hair Loss & Thinning Evaluation
- **Canonical URL:** https://www.medicareskin.com/treatments/hair/hair-loss-treatment/
- **SEO Title:** Hair Loss Treatment in Bangalore | Medicare Skin
- **Meta Description:** Hair fall, widening parting or patchy hair loss? Learn about diagnosis, targeted blood tests, medicines and PRP options with a South Bengaluru dermatologist.
- **Primary Intent:** Hair fall treatment Bangalore; hair loss dermatologist South Bangalore.
- **Diagnostic Approach:** Differentiating hair shedding (telogen effluvium triggered by illness, fever, postpartum, stress) from follicular miniaturization (androgenetic pattern alopecia) and autoimmune causes (alopecia areata).
- **Targeted Investigations:** Trichoscopy examination, hair-pull evaluation, and selective blood tests (CBC, serum ferritin/iron studies, thyroid function) when clinically indicated rather than indiscriminate multi-test commercial packages.
- **Management:** Evidence-based medical therapy (topical minoxidil, oral anti-androgens for eligible males, nutritional correction) with regenerative injection therapies (PRP) considered as selective adjuncts.

### Page 05: HydraFacial & Hydrodermabrasion
- **Canonical URL:** https://www.medicareskin.com/treatments/aesthetics/hydrafacial/
- **SEO Title:** HydraFacial in Bangalore | Hydration & Skin Glow Guide
- **Meta Description:** Explore device-assisted cleansing, exfoliation and hydration for dull skin. Benefits, suitability, aftercare and costs explained by a South Bengaluru dermatology clinic.
- **Primary Intent:** HydraFacial Bangalore; facial for skin glow South Bangalore.
- **Device & Trademark Verification:** HydraFacial is a specific registered trademark. Clinical service availability requires verification of authentic equipment; otherwise referred to generic device-assisted hydrodermabrasion.
- **Clinical Mechanism:** Multi-stage mechanical and chemical exfoliation, vacuum extraction of superficial sebum, and topical serum infusion to enhance temporary radiance and epidermal hydration.
- **Contraindications:** Not a cure for inflammatory acne, melasma, or enlarged pores. Contraindicated in active skin barrier breakdown, untreated dermatitis, or active herpes simplex lesions.

### Page 06: Chemical Peels
- **Canonical URL:** https://www.medicareskin.com/treatments/skin/chemical-peels/
- **SEO Title:** Chemical Peels in Bangalore | Acne Marks & Skin Texture
- **Meta Description:** Learn about chemical peel types, benefits, downtime and pigmentation risks in Indian skin. Dermatologist-guided peel consultation near Yelachenahalli.
- **Primary Intent:** Chemical peel treatment Bangalore; face peel dermatologist Bengaluru.
- **Clinical Spectrum:** Superficial peels (glycolic, salicylic, lactic, mandelic) gently exfoliate the stratum corneum for texture, post-acne macules, and mild comedonal acne. Medium and deep peels require extensive downtime and carry heightened post-inflammatory pigmentation risks in Indian skin.
- **Safety Precaution:** Professional in-clinic application only. Over-the-counter high-strength acid peels carried out without dermatological supervision risk chemical burns and prolonged hyperpigmentation.

### Page 07: PRP vs GFC Hair Treatment
- **Canonical URL:** https://www.medicareskin.com/treatments/hair/prp-gfc/
- **SEO Title:** PRP vs GFC Hair Treatment Bangalore | Medicare Skin
- **Meta Description:** Understand PRP and GFC hair injections, evidence for pattern hair loss, side effects, sessions and cost. Get a dermatologist-led hair assessment in Bengaluru.
- **Primary Intent:** PRP hair treatment Bangalore; GFC hair treatment Bangalore.
- **Comparative Evidence:** Platelet-Rich Plasma (PRP) concentrates autologous platelets to release biological growth factors with documented systematic review support in pattern alopecia. Growth Factor Concentrate (GFC) utilizes proprietary activation kits to isolate growth factors. Current published clinical evidence does not demonstrate consistent superiority of GFC over PRP. Neither procedure contains stem cells nor regrows hair on completely bald, scarred scalps.
- **Safety:** Autologous blood processing with strict aseptic protocols; contraindicated in platelet dysfunction, bleeding disorders, or scalp infections.

### Page 08: Eczema & Atopic Dermatitis
- **Canonical URL:** https://www.medicareskin.com/treatments/medical-dermatology/eczema/
- **SEO Title:** Eczema Treatment in Bangalore | Itchy Skin Dermatologist
- **Meta Description:** Understand eczema symptoms, triggers, moisturizers, steroid creams and newer treatment options. Dermatologist consultation near Yelachenahalli, Bengaluru.
- **Primary Intent:** Eczema doctor Bangalore; eczema treatment dermatologist South Bengaluru.
- **Clinical Presentation:** Pruritic, erythematous, or lichenified skin lesions. In skin of colour, eczema often manifests as hyperpigmented, violaceous, or greyish plaques rather than bright red erythema.
- **Therapeutic Strategy:** Barrier repair with fragrance-free emollients; prudent, short-course topical corticosteroids or calcineurin inhibitors for acute flares; trigger avoidance (harsh soaps, friction, sweat); infection surveillance. Eczema is chronic and non-contagious.

### Page 09: Psoriasis Management
- **Canonical URL:** https://www.medicareskin.com/treatments/medical-dermatology/psoriasis/
- **SEO Title:** Psoriasis Treatment in Bangalore | Medicare Skin
- **Meta Description:** Learn psoriasis causes, plaques, scalp and nail symptoms, treatment choices and psoriatic arthritis warning signs. Dermatologist in South Bengaluru.
- **Primary Intent:** Psoriasis dermatologist Bangalore; psoriasis treatment South Bengaluru.
- **Clinical Features:** Well-demarcated plaques with silvery-white micaceous scaling affecting elbows, knees, scalp, nails, and lumbosacral regions. Psoriasis is immune-mediated and non-contagious.
- **Multisystem Awareness:** Recognition of psoriatic arthritis flags (morning stiffness, enthesitis, dactylitis/sausage digits).
- **Treatment Hierarchy:** Topical keratolytics and corticosteroids/calcipotriol for localized disease; phototherapy or systemic/biologic medications for moderate-to-severe disease following thorough pre-treatment screening.

### Page 10: Vitiligo & Depigmentation Evaluation
- **Canonical URL:** https://www.medicareskin.com/treatments/medical-dermatology/vitiligo/
- **SEO Title:** Vitiligo Treatment in Bangalore | White Patch Dermatologist
- **Meta Description:** White patches on your skin? Learn how vitiligo is diagnosed, its treatment options, phototherapy and realistic repigmentation expectations in Bengaluru.
- **Primary Intent:** Vitiligo treatment Bangalore; dermatologist for white patches South Bengaluru.
- **Clinical Nature:** Autoimmune loss or dysfunction of epidermal melanocytes causing amelanotic macules and patches. Non-contagious and not caused by dietary imbalances.
- **Differential Diagnosis:** Wood's lamp and clinical differentiation from pityriasis versicolor, post-inflammatory hypopigmentation, and pityriasis alba.
- **Management:** Topical immunomodulators (corticosteroids, tacrolimus); targeted phototherapy (NB-UVB); surgical grafting for strictly stable, refractory non-segmental/segmental vitiligo; cosmetic camouflage. Repigmentation takes months, and facial lesions respond more reliably than acral (fingertips, lips) sites.
